title: AWS EC2
content: Amazon EC2 (Elastic Compute Cloud) is an Amazon Web Services web service providing resizable virtual server instances for running applications on remote data centers with a pay-as-you-go pricing model.

title: BGP Overview
content: Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) is the core routing protocol that acts as the 'postal service' of the Internet, managing how data moves between independent networks known as Autonomous Systems (AS). It enables efficient path selection, prevents routing loops, and allows organizations and ISPs to exchange routing information

title: Rust Intro
content: Rust frees memory without a garbage collector by using a compile-time ownership system paired with RAII (Resource Acquisition Is Initialization). Instead of tracking memory at runtime, the Rust compiler automatically inserts precise deallocation instructions into your compiled code exactly where data is no longer needed.
